identity: ONE original flying manta creature, the Gloambell Wake Manta, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter side view, hovering in the air. Keep the two large upswept wing fins in pale cream with deep navy-blue patterning and scalloped edges, the smooth white beaked head, the ribbed pale cream belly, the forked tail fins, and the FIVE slender dangling tendrils that each end in ONE small softly glowing white bell lantern. No rider and no extra wings. Preserve the two wings, the five bell tendrils, the beaked head and the graceful proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed scale and centred body. Keep both wing tips, the tail fins and every bell within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, water, light bursts, beams, rings, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs; glow stays only inside the five small bells. The wings bend smoothly; the body never morphs.

idle_h3_v1.action: Hover in place in a gentle loop. The wings ripple and beat slowly up and down, the body bobs a little, the tail fins flick and the five bell tendrils sway beneath, then everything returns smoothly to the original hovering pose. The body stays centred in the air. No flying off and no attack.

move_h3_v1.action: Fly in place through two complete wingbeat cycles. The two wings sweep fully down and fold under the body, then rise back up high, while the body stays centred for engine-driven travel and the bell tendrils trail back and swing. Finish in the original wing phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE diving strike toward screen right. The manta raises both wings high and draws back, then sweeps the wings down and darts forward so the beaked head stabs to full reach at screen right, then glides back and settles into the original hovering pose. One strike only; no effect at contact.

ranged_h3_v1.action: Make ONE bell volley toward screen right. The manta swings all five bell tendrils forward together toward screen right as the bells glow brighter inside, holds them there a moment, then the tendrils snap back and the bells dim as it settles into the original hovering pose. Nothing is released from the bells: no light bursts, beams, rings or projectiles.

hit_h3_v1.action: Start rocked back in a flinch, then recover completely. The manta curls up tight, the wings snapping down around the body and the tendrils bunching, then it unfurls the wings and returns to the same hovering pose. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Wrap up: the manta folds both wings down and around its body like a cloak, tucking the head and the bell tendrils inside, then holds the wrapped guard while hovering. No attack and no return to the open-winged pose.

cast_h3_v1.action: A tolling signal. The manta lifts its wings and swings the five bell tendrils in a slow wave so the bells ring and glow a little brighter inside, holds the pose briefly, then settles back into the original hovering pose. Only the bells brighten; no rings, beams or spell effect.

death_h3_v1.action: Fall and lie still. The bells dim, the wings go limp and the manta sinks slowly down to the ground, lands with the wings drooping, stays a moment, then flattens out with both wings spread flat on the ground and the tendrils lying beneath, finishing motionless with the head at screen right. The same body throughout: no dissolving and no disappearing.
